Dear $patient_name,

Your dental appointment is complete. This is a summary of what was done, for your records.

=== APPOINTMENT ===
Reference: $appointment_ref
Date: $treatment_date
Dentist: $dentist_name
Treatment: $treatment_type

=== WHAT WAS FOUND ===
$diagnosis

=== WHAT WAS DONE ===
$procedure_notes

=== COST AND PAYMENT ===
Fee: £$fee
Payment Status: $payment_status
$payment_note

=== AFTERCARE ===
- If you were given anaesthetic, avoid hot drinks and take care not to bite your cheek or tongue until the numbness wears off.
- Some tenderness for a day or two is normal. Ordinary painkillers are usually enough.
- Brush and floss as usual unless your dentist told you otherwise.

=== WHEN TO CONTACT US ===
Get in touch if you have:
- pain that is getting worse rather than better after 2-3 days
- swelling, a fever, or a bad taste that will not go away
- a filling or crown that feels loose or comes out
- bleeding that does not stop

Out of hours, for severe pain or facial swelling, contact the emergency dental service or call 111.

=== NEXT APPOINTMENT ===
$next_steps

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
University Dental Clinic: dental@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Best regards,
University Dental Clinic

$signature
